item.title: watchOS 27.3 Introduces Live Rewind & Siri Recap
item.description: Apple’s watchOS 27.3 beta adds Audio Intelligence, letting users replay the last 15 seconds of speech and get AI‑generated conversation summaries.

item.title: Apple watchOS 27.3 Beta Launches Audio Intelligence
item.description: Apple’s watchOS 27.3 developer beta adds audio intelligence, Siri Recap, Live Rewind, a redesigned Health app, and broader language support.

item.title: Apple Watch AI Intelligence Beta: Live Rewind & Recaps
item.description: Apple’s Audio Intelligence AI enters beta on Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, bringing sound, song, Live Rewind and Siri Recap with on‑device privacy.
